items.title: 4.9.1 Significance of stoichiometry in medicine (medicine mein stoichiometry ki ahmiyat) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.9.1, printed page 91, with a self-check.

blocks.text: Stoichiometry medicine (ilaj) ki field mein bohat aham hai aur in kaamon mein istemal hoti hai:

items: Antibiotics banate waqt stoichiometry yaqeeni banati hai ke har dose mein active ingredient sahi amount mein ho aur target bacteria ke mutabiq ho.
Mareezon ke khoon mein cholesterol ka level maloom karne ke liye. Cholesterol fat (charbi) ki ek qism hai jo sari buri nahi, lekin nuqsan bhi de sakti hai.
Diabetes ke mareez ke khoon mein glucose ka level maloom karne ke liye. Insulin ka istemal blood sugar ko theek control karne ke liye stoichiometry par depend karta hai.

Athletes (khiladiyon) ke urine (peshab) mein steroids aur doosre stimulants (jism ko tez karne wali dawaein) pakarne ke liye. Athletes inhein performance aur strength (taqat) barhane ke liye lete hain.
Vaccine banate waqt viral antigens ki concentration maloom karne ke liye, taake vaccine asar kare.

Mareez ko dawa ki kitni amount aur kitni dafa deni hai, yeh tai karne ke liye. Kam amount mein dawa be-asar hoti hai, aur zyada amount toxic (zehreeli) state ya maut ki wajah ban sakti hai. Paracetamol dard aur bukhar kam karne ke liye hai; is ki overdose khoon patla kar sakti hai aur organs (jism ke hisse), khaas taur par liver (jigar), ko bohat zyada nuqsan pohncha sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Paracetamol ki sahi dose kyun aham hai, aur pharmacist dose nikalte waqt stoichiometry ka kaun sa khayal istemal karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Bohat kam paracetamol be-asar hai, aur overdose khoon patla kar ke liver aur doosre organs ko nuqsan deti hai. Pharmacist mass, molar mass, moles aur concentration ke relationship se mareez ke liye active ingredient ki theek amount nikalta hai.

items: Stoichiometry antibiotic doses tai karti hai, khoon mein cholesterol aur glucose naapti hai, athletes mein steroids pakarti hai, vaccine mein antigen ki concentration tai karti hai, aur safe dose nikalti hai (paracetamol overdose liver ko nuqsan deti hai).
